method: Qualitative product-task review of populated report pixels, semantics and responsive composition; no aesthetic score or controlled human-preference claim.
shared_product_identity: Company type hierarchy, surfaces, section rails, blue data accents and responsive single-column reading remain recognizable across reports.
task_direction_assessment: A/B/C/D/E/F materially vary the decision object and data shape: executive regional performance; spatial fab RCA; paired-cohort experiment; shift handoff; time/resource reserve dispatch; batch disposition. No mechanically repeated grammar was observed to override these task hierarchies.

A.decision: Proceed with monitored revenue recovery while closing the South retention gap.
A.truth: Revenue totals 551 across North/South/West; South retention is 92.8% against a 95% target; Q1–Q4 retention rises from 91.8% to 94.6%.
A.character: Executive decision brief with a single headline, short context, regional evidence table, retention trend, risk callout and next step.
A.negative_identity: Not a general-purpose dashboard or a pile of KPI cards.
A.density: Moderate; three regional rows and a four-quarter series support the decision.
A.salience: Decision headline first; regional comparison and trend second; action/risk after supporting evidence.
A.typography: Large report headline; small subordinate context; compact table headers/body; chart title/axes; emphatic KPI values; body copy for rationale.
A.spacing: Opening headline/context share a band; evidence and analysis have separate section gaps; support metrics form one group; decision and next step close the document.
A.surfaces: Light report canvas; table, risk callout and KPI containers separate content groups.
A.feature_support: Headline and regional table lead; trend confirms; risk and next-step provide action.
A.color: Blue is neutral data/table accent; red text marks risk; green status marks review.
A.data_density: Three region rows; four ordered quarters; no small-multiple grid.
A.responsive: One-column ordered report at 390; narrative and metrics remain legible.
A.risk: The favorable regional total could distract from the below-target South; headline and risk text state the gap.

B.person: Fab process engineer coordinating Quality and Equipment Engineering
B.decision: Contain lot L2407 until chamber A verification and paired reference confirm recovery.
B.truth: Affected yield is 94.2% vs 98.6% reference, with localized die loss; ETCH-08 chamber A pressure is +2.1%; 81-die wafer map, SPC time line and Reference/Affected box plot.
B.negative_identity: Not a generic executive status deck; spatial signature and process sequence are central.
B.density: High; wafer map, image crop, SPC, distribution, evidence table, finding and corrective action.
B.salience: Containment headline; process-flow/evidence; wafer map and measured comparisons; corrective action.
B.typography: Investigation statement; brief scope; section rails; chart/table labels; status/evidence card text.
B.spacing: Engineering evidence grouped above analysis; action and KPIs separated into later sections.
B.surfaces: Bounded engineering evidence and callout surfaces; wafer content clipped within its spatial boundary.
B.feature_support: Wafer map and SPC/distribution are feature evidence; cropped image duplicates the same die data and is support.
B.color: Blue/orange wafer scale carries measurement direction; red risk statement; green verified status.
B.data_density: 81 die marks plus 4 time observations and 3 ledger rows.
B.responsive: 390 and 320 recompose to ordered single column; flow is semantically stacked; table exposes horizontal scroll.
B.risk: A reader may treat the image crop as independent evidence; its caption says it is the same measurements. Report image has no reader zoom/pan/fit controls.

C.person: Growth experimentation lead and quality partner
C.decision: Stage a limited treatment rollout while keeping the agreed quality guardrail and long-term-retention uncertainty explicit.
C.truth: Treatment conversion moves 8.2% to 9.8%; control 8.0% to 8.5%; three cohorts remain inside the guardrail; four weeks do not establish long-term retention.
C.character: Paired-cohort analytical narrative with explicit limits.
C.density: High but grouped: two-series weekly chart, cohort box plot, evidence table, interpretation and recommendation.
C.salience: Caveated conclusion; paired weekly trend; cohort distribution; denominator/guardrail table; rollout scope.
C.typography: Statement, context, explanatory paragraph, compact cohort table, chart labels, recommendation and KPIs.
C.spacing: Trend and interpretation sit as a feature/support pair; distribution follows; table supplies cohort facts; recommendation closes.
C.surfaces: Separate table, recommendation and KPI surfaces; charts sit in analytical space.
C.feature_support: Line trend leads; distribution tests spread; table grounds sample sizes and guardrail.
C.color: Distinct blue and red/green series; semantic recommendation/status accents.
C.data_density: Four time categories x two series; box distributions for both cohorts; three table rows.
C.tone: Cautious inference, no causal certainty beyond sample.
C.responsive: 390 one-column ordered reading with charts and table following narrative.
C.risk: A reader could overstate treatment effect if missing the explicit four-week/retention limitation.

D.person: Shift supervisor with Quality and Equipment Engineering
D.decision: Keep the recipe locked until the paired-lot check closes two open items.
D.truth: Shift yield recovers 94.1% to 95.0%; critical measurement trend includes SPC/spec context; ETCH-08 chamber A pressure remains open; paired lot verification is next.
D.character: Operational handoff combining status, trend, sequence, ownership, and follow-up.
D.negative_identity: Not a single-metric green status page.
D.density: High; two charts, narrative, four-step flow, five-column evidence ledger, evidence/risk/project cards and KPIs.
D.salience: Shift handoff headline and action; critical measurements and evidence ownership; risks and project follow-up.
D.typography: Compact engineering title and context; chart labels; ledger headers; workflow stage labels; narrative and status.
D.spacing: Trend/narrative are grouped; process flow follows; table and evidence card are distinct; risk and project close before metrics.
D.surfaces: Table, evidence, risk and project are separately bounded; no nested overflow.
D.feature_support: Status narrative and measurement trend lead; process flow and ledger explain verification.
D.color: Blue charts/table headings; red hold status; green verified/stable states.
D.data_density: Two time series plus three shift observations and three operational ledger rows.
D.tone: Actionable handoff with explicit owner and due condition.
D.responsive: 390 and 320 ordered single column; horizontal table affordance remains.
D.risk: Trend recovery could be mistaken for release readiness; hold/action copy states paired-lot check remains open.

E.task: Fresh dense/mixed-evidence holdout: evening reserve dispatch
E.person: Grid dispatch controller and balancing-desk operator
E.decision: Retain a 7 MW backup block until telemetry confirms demand-response delivery at 20:45.
E.truth: At 20:30 supply is 63 MW versus 70 MW requirement; 27 rows span nine half-hour windows and three resources; demand-response telemetry is pending.
E.character: Clock-driven operations brief with ledger, workflow, chart, decision/risk, interpretation and release condition.
E.negative_identity: Not a generic quarterly analytics page.
E.density: Dense; 27 source rows, nine x-categories, three series, four commitment rows and prose.
E.salience: Reserve shortfall and HOLD status; commitments table; action time; resource trend.
E.typography: Decision statement; concise operating context; table IDs/units; narrative; chart labels; status and next step.
E.spacing: Decision and table lead; next step and interpretation separate; chart then KPI comparison.
E.surfaces: Contained 5-column ledger and decision surface; chart and KPIs remain distinct.
E.feature_support: Commitment table and explicit status lead; multi-series time chart supports.
E.color: Three series have separate series colors; HOLD is explicit; blue emphasizes numeric comparison.
E.data_density: Nine time categories x 3 resource series and four commitment rows.
E.tone: Operationally cautious; provisional data separated from verified data.
E.responsive: 1440/390/320 no body spill; table has scroll cue and keyboard/touch affordance; process flow stacks semantically.
E.risk: Export renderer compresses category and legend labels until adjacent labels touch; series identity remains in OOXML but is visually hard to parse.

F.task: Fresh sparse/decision-led holdout: sterile fill batch release
F.decision: Hold batch SF-14-0826 until the missing sterility assay is reviewed.
F.truth: 2 of 3 release checks are confirmed; retain sample SF14-R3 has no result; assay window is 48h; sterile release target is 3/3.
F.character: Sparse, explicitly decision-led disposition brief with a precise evidence ledger and one supporting status chart.
F.negative_identity: Not a broad manufacturing dashboard; no decorative charts.
F.density: Sparse-to-moderate; 3 evidence rows and three release checks, ample focus on disposition/rationale.
F.salience: Hold decision and missing assay; complete three-row ledger; rationale/status; next action; 2/3 metric.
F.typography: Large disposition statement; context, ledger headers, plain narrative, chart title, status and next-step line.
F.spacing: Decision first, evidence second, rationale and action then metric support.
F.surfaces: Ledger and decision/risk surfaces contain evidence and status.
F.feature_support: Decision and evidence ledger lead; bar chart summarizes the three checks.
F.color: Blue data labels; status makes HOLD explicit; no color-only distinction required.
F.data_density: Three checks/categories; 2 complete, 1 missing; three table rows.
F.responsive: 1440/390/360/320 inspected; no spill/collision; decision/rationale/status and values/delta/target visible; table scrolling is discoverable.
F.risk: A 2/3 summary can be mistaken for release readiness absent the missing sterility row; headline and disposition say hold.
